title: CRESTBOUND
tagline: Seven Crests to a course. Four realms. One very good jump.
howToPlay: WASD moves Nim on an analog curve — a tap walks, a hold runs. Turning is tight at walking speed and wide at a full run, so line up a fast approach before a long gap.
SPACE jumps. Land and press it again straight away to chain a double jump, then a third, higher one with a flip. The chain breaks if you wait, so keep the rhythm.
Hold CROUCH (CTRL or C) and jump while running for a LONG JUMP — low, fast, and the furthest you can travel. From a standstill the same input is a BACKFLIP, straight up.
F is a DIVE. In the air it stretches a jump; on the ground it becomes a belly slide you can cancel with another jump.
Press CROUCH in mid-air for a GROUND POUND — it breaks crates, triggers switches, and a jump right after it launches you higher than anything else.
Jump into a wall and press SPACE to WALL KICK off it. Narrow shafts are meant to be climbed by alternating kicks.
Q and E orbit the camera, Z snaps it behind you, and G peeks in first person when you want to judge a drop.

Every course hides SEVEN CRESTS: one in the open, one for eight Sigils, one for a hundred coins, a secret, a Warden, a race, and a power hat. Grab any of them and the course is cleared — the rest are yours to come back for.
Crests unlock the Keep's paintings. The more you find, the deeper into the castle you get.
tips: The triple jump is the highest jump in the game and the answer to most ledges you think you cannot reach.
The long jump is the answer to most gaps you think you cannot cross — take a straight run-up first.
Hazards run on a fixed clock, not on luck. Watch one full cycle before you commit and it will present the same timing every attempt.
Sigils always sit on the risky line: the ledge you would not normally take, the tree top, the pond floor.
Death rewinds you to the last checkpoint in under a second, and checkpoints sit right before the hard parts. Trying the bold route costs almost nothing.
If a jump keeps failing, add a dive to it — diving out of a jump carries you noticeably further.
credits: Built by ForgeFlow Labs. Procedural Web Audio score, procedural PBR materials, no third-party game assets.
